description: A free photo collage maker: drop in your photos, pick a layout, download one picture. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

background.description: The colour behind and between the photos, as #rrggbb.

corners.description: Corner rounding on each photo: square, soft or round.

format.description: jpeg (smaller, best for photos) or png (lossless).

images.description: The photos in order, at most 20. The first fills the first space (the big one in the big-* layouts), and so on.

data.description: The photo's file bytes, base64-encoded. A data: URL prefix is tolerated and stripped.

focusX.description: Which part of the photo stays in view when it is cropped to fill its space, left to right: 0 keeps the left edge, 0.5 the centre, 1 the right edge.

focusY.description: The same from top to bottom: 0 keeps the top, 0.5 the centre, 1 the bottom.

type.description: The MIME type of the bytes: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp. HEIC and AVIF are read on the tool's page only.

layout.description: grid: an even grid that adapts to however many photos there are. two-side: 2 side by side. two-stack: 2 stacked. big-left-2: one big photo on the left with 2 beside it. big-top-2: one big on top with 2 below. big-left-3: one big on the left with 3 beside it. big-top-3: one big on top with 3 below. A fixed layout uses as many photos as it has spaces; extra photos are left out and missing ones leave a space in the background colour.

shape.description: The finished picture's shape: square (1:1), portrait (4:5, an Instagram post), landscape (16:9) or story (9:16, for stories and reels).

size.description: The long edge of the finished picture in pixels: 1080 or 2048. The tool's page also makes 4096.

spacing.description: The border between and around the photos: none, thin, medium or wide. It scales with the picture's size.

name: collage_maker
title: Collage Maker
